rows.jyutping: waang4 kwaa1 daai6 sai1 joeng4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something that crosses or spans the Atlantic.

example.english: The transatlantic route connects Hong Kong and New York.
example.traditional: 橫跨大西洋嘅航線連接香港同紐約。
example.jyutping: waang4 kwaa1 daai6 sai1 joeng4 ge3 hong4 sin3 lin4 zip3 hoeng1 gong2 tung4 nau2 joek3

rows.jyutping: daai6 sai1 joeng4 ling6 jat1 bin1 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when the thing is on or comes from the other side of the Atlantic.

example.english: My transatlantic relatives are coming to Hong Kong tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我大西洋另一邊嘅親戚聽日嚟香港。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 sai1 joeng4 ling6 jat1 bin1 ge3 can1 cik1 ting1 jat6 lai4 hoeng1 gong2

rows.jyutping: daai6 sai1 joeng4 loeng5 ngon6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for something involving both sides of the Atlantic, such as relations or cooperation.

example.english: Transatlantic cooperation has grown in recent years.
example.traditional: 大西洋兩岸嘅合作近年多咗。
example.jyutping: daai6 sai1 joeng4 loeng5 ngon6 ge3 hap6 zok3 gan6 nin4 do1 zo2
